nodes.summary: There are a finite tape alphabet $\Gamma$ with a blank symbol, decidable equality and a primitive recursive coding, a type of states $\Lambda$ with a start state, a single-tape Turing machine $M$ with alphabet $\Gamma$ and states $\Lambda$, and a finite set $S$ of states that contains the start state and is closed under the transitions of $M$, such that the set of input words on which $M$ halts is not decidable by…
nodes.title: The halting problem for single-tape machines is undecidable

nodes.summary: A finite type $\alpha$ with $n$ elements gets the primitive recursive coding transported from $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$ along a fixed (noncanonically chosen) bijection between $\alpha$ and $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$.
nodes.title: Primitive recursive coding of a finite type

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a multi-stack machine together with a bijection $e$ from the alphabet of its input stack to the Booleans, and suppose the tape alphabet $\Gamma'$ of the single-tape emulation of $M$ is finite and carries a primitive recursive coding. Then the map sending $n \in \mathbb{N}$ to the initial tape of the emulation on the input word $e^{-1}(b_1) \cdots e^{-1}(b_m)$, where $b_1 \cdots b_m$ is the binary code of…
nodes.title: The input encoding of the single-tape emulation is primitive recursive

nodes.summary: A single-tape Turing machine $M$ halts on an input word $l$ when its run, started in its start state with $l$ on the tape, reaches a halting configuration.
nodes.title: Halting of a single-tape machine

nodes.summary: A multi-stack machine halts on a word $l$ over the alphabet of its input stack if and only if the evaluation of its transition function, started at its main label and initial internal state with $l$ on the input stack and all other stacks empty, is defined.
nodes.title: Halting agrees with evaluation for multi-stack machines

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
